description: Scoring System Fixes - Fix timing tolerance, consolidate matching logic, and improve test coverage

effect.notes: Functional TypeScript framework. Use Schema.TaggedError for domain errors, catchTag for discriminated handling.

bun.notes: Runtime and test runner. Tests use @codeforbreakfast/bun-test-effect for Effect integration.

cloudflare.notes: Durable Objects for session state. session-do.ts is outside Effect runtime by design.

testing_policy.mandatory: EVERY story MUST include tests. A story is NOT complete without passing tests.
testing_policy.no_exceptions: Do NOT mark a story as complete if tests are missing or failing.

stories.title: Fix 300ms to 150ms timing tolerance bug
stories.description: session-do.ts:453 uses TIMING_TOLERANCE_MS * 2 (300ms) instead of the specified 150ms tolerance. Remove the erroneous multiplier.
acceptance_criteria: TIMING_TOLERANCE_MS used directly without * 2 multiplier
Note at 149ms offset marked correct
Note at 151ms offset marked wrong
comparison.ts uses same tolerance value
Edge case tests added at tolerance boundary
bun test passes

technical_details.pattern: Single source of truth for timing constants

stories.title: Consolidate duplicate note matching logic
stories.description: Create shared pure note-matching module to eliminate duplicate algorithms in comparison.ts (orders by distance) and session-do.ts (orders by startTime).
acceptance_criteria: New packages/shared/src/note-matching.ts with zero Effect dependencies
Canonical behavior: order by timing distance (closest first)
comparison.ts imports and uses shared matchNote function
session-do.ts imports and uses same shared matchNote function
Unit tests verify identical results from both code paths
Tests cover: various timing offsets, chords, out-of-order playing
bun test passes

stories.title: Add critical test coverage for scoring behavior
stories.description: Add missing tests for chord handling, tolerance boundaries, local vs WebSocket parity, and edge cases.
acceptance_criteria: Chord tests: in-order, out-of-order, partial chord playing
Timing tolerance boundary tests at 149ms, 150ms, 151ms
Parity test comparing comparison.ts and session-do.ts results
Edge case tests: rapid repeated notes, out-of-order timestamps
All new tests pass
bun test passes

technical_details.pattern: Edge case coverage for scoring correctness

stories.title: Define timing contract with branded types
stories.description: Create clear types for PieceTime, SessionTime, and PlaybackTime to prevent conflation of timing reference frames.
acceptance_criteria: packages/shared/src/timing.ts with branded types
PieceTime: ms from piece start (Verovio onset)
SessionTime: ms from session start
PlaybackTime: ms from first played note
Conversion functions between reference frames
Audit complete: all timestamp usages documented
bun test passes

stories.title: Fix chord note coloring for out-of-order playing
stories.description: Update useNoteColoring.ts to use time-based matching instead of sequential per-pitch indexing for chords.
acceptance_criteria: Chord notes matched by timing proximity, not pitch index order
All notes in chord eligible simultaneously regardless of play order
Track colored state per note element ID, not per pitch index
Test: C4-E4-G4 in order -> all green
Test: E4-C4-G4 out of order -> all green
Test: Miss one chord note -> that note red, others green
bun test passes

stories.title: Fix playhead tempo alignment for missed note detection
stories.description: Add tempo conversion so missed note detection uses consistent time reference with playhead position.
acceptance_criteria: pieceToPlaybackTime and playbackToPieceTime conversion functions
Missed note detection applies tempo conversion to onset times
At tempo 50%: notes not marked missed too early
At tempo 150%: notes not marked missed too late
Visual playhead crosses notes at moment they're due
bun test passes

stories.title: Fix voice/backup handling in MusicXML parser
stories.description: Refactor musicxml.ts to process backup/forward elements in document order for correct multi-voice timing.
acceptance_criteria: Process measure children in document order
Cursor moves backward on <backup>, forward on <forward>
Voice state tracking for voice-specific timing
Test files: two-voice treble, piano grand staff
Bach invention parses with correct timings
bun test passes

stories.title: Add missing fields to WebSocket result messages
stories.description: Extend NoteResultMessage to include expectedTime, playedTime, and offsetMs for proper client timing feedback.
acceptance_criteria: NoteResultMessage includes playedTime, expectedTime, offsetMs fields
session-do.ts sends all timing fields in result messages
useSession.ts uses actual expectedTime, not playedTime copy
No type errors between shared types and usage
bun test passes

stories.title: Implement full session state persistence in DO
stories.description: Persist playedNotes and matchResults to DO storage for recovery on reconnect, with debounced writes and session timeout.
acceptance_criteria: PersistedSessionState schema defined
playedNotes and matchResults persisted (debounced, max 1/sec)
State restored on reconnect
Session timeout alarm cleans up after 1 hour idle
Test: simulate DO eviction, verify state restored
bun test passes

stories.title: Remove debug console.log statements
stories.description: Clean up [DEBUG] logs from session-do.ts, keep essential error logging with structured format.
acceptance_criteria: No [DEBUG] prefixed console.log in production code
Essential logs (errors, session start/end) use structured format
LOG_LEVEL env var controls debug output
bun test passes
